results.title: Spaceship.com Review 2026: Honest Deep Dive After 50+ Domains
results.content:
What are the main complaints about Spaceship?

The most consistent negative patterns are: account suspensions without advance notice (sometimes triggered by third-party abuse reports), no phone support, VPN-related checkout errors that break promo codes, and occasional delays on KYC verification for premium domain purchases. These are real issues, worth knowing before you consolidate your entire portfolio here.

Is Spaceship good for bulk domain management?

For portfolios with fewer than 50 domains: yes, confidently. For larger portfolios with diverse TLD needs, the narrower catalog might be a constraint. The API makes programmatic management straightforward for developers.

## Final Verdict [...] No phone support. Full stop. If you’re managing domains for clients who panic when something breaks at 2am, or if you personally want the option to talk to a human being, Spaceship doesn’t offer that. Live chat is available and generally responsive, but quality is inconsistent. Some agents are sharp, some are reading from a script in a way that’s obvious.

Account suspensions without warning. This is the complaint pattern I take most seriously in the negative reviews. Multiple users have reported having accounts suspended for “fraudulent activity” with no advance notice and no clear recourse. [...] Can I transfer my domains to Spaceship?

Yes. The transfer process is standard: unlock your domain at your current registrar, retrieve the auth code, and initiate the transfer in Spaceship. In my experience, transfers take 5-7 days and go smoothly. One note: the receiving domain gets a one-year renewal added at transfer, so factor that into your timing.

Is there a Spaceship API?

Yes, a full REST API documented at spaceship.dev/api/v1 using OpenAPI 3.0. It covers domains, DNS records, contacts, nameservers, and SellerHub listings. It’s one of the cleanest registrar APIs available right now.
